### Root Cause
1. In [`Driver.route`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L360-L372), the driver splits a patient message on conjunctions (`and`, `then`, `also`, `plus`, `;`) and queues any subsequent clause containing an action verb (`book|schedule|cancel|move|reschedule`) into `self.queue` with only that clause's text.
2. When the first clause targets someone else's appointment, [`Driver.cancel`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L533-L538) calls [`Driver.not_yours`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L529-L531), which calls [`Driver.finish`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L308-L316).
3. `Driver.finish` immediately pops the queued `("cancel", c)` item and invokes `Driver.cancel(c)` in the same reply. Because the isolated clause `c` lacks the relative's appointment ID, date, time, or provider, [`Driver.resolve_appt`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L525-L526) falls back to `mine[0]` whenever `len(mine) == 1`, and if `explicit_confirm(c)` is true, `Driver.cancel` immediately calls `do_cancel()` on the patient's own appointment.
